faqs.question: How can I get into JNAFAU SPA - School of Planning and Architecture for UG/PG courses? Am I eligible for admission?
faqs.answer:
JNAFAU SPA - School of Planning and Architecture has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
PG Diploma Anygraduation. (B.Arch, B.Tech, (civil), B.Plan is preferred)
M.E./M.Tech Candidate must have completed B.E/B.Tech (Civil Engineering)/ B.Planning/ B.Tech (Planning)/ B.Arch/AIIA/ M.A. / M.Sc. (Sociology /Economics, / Geography) from any recognised University/Institute.
B.Arch Candidate who have passed 10+3 Diploma Examination with Mathematics as compulsory subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate from a recognised Institute/ University can also apply. Candidates appearing for 10+3 Diploma with Mathematics in the current year may also provisionally appear for NATA-2023.
B.Des Candidate must have passed 10+2 from recognised board.
B.E. / B.Tech Candidates who have passed or appeared at the final year of the Diploma examination in Engineering conducted by the State Board of Technical Education and Training, Telangana / Andhra Pradesh or any other examination recognised as equivalent thereto by the State Board of Technical Education and Training, Telangana / Andhra Pradesh. Candidates should have completed 16 years of age, as on 31st December of the year of admission. There is no upper age limit.
M.Arch Candidate must have completed B.Arch / AIIA from any recognised University/Institute.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Des. in Interior Design - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, you make good friends and go on educational trips but the faculty here is egoistic.

review_content.Placements: As far as I've seen in the college, there happened a placement drive in which out of 65, only 12 were selected. This college doesn't teach everything and you're supposed to learn everything on your own, be it market surveys, case studies, and everything. You have to learn all the software on your own.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi at the college. There is no strong signal either. You have computer labs which are of old versions. Classrooms are okay, but in our classroom which is the 5th-floor 3rd studio. There is water leakage and there are no proper lockers or storage to keep our stuff. Benches are broken sometimes. Some can case bruises. There is no hostel in our college, so I don't know about the hostel.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Digital Techniques for Design and Planning (DTDP) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Lucky enough to find a place like this to learn.

review_content.Placements: I am 2022 batch, most of my classmates got placed or started as trainees in reputed corporates of Hyderabad. There were 58 members and around 48 members were placed in good companies. Most of the jobs were entry-level jobs. We got internships in many start-up companies in Jubilee Hills and Madhapur.
review_content.Infrastructure: The institute was well-equipped with books, computers, Wi-Fi, laboratories, library, and tools whichever were needed for the course. We had a canteen and hostel facility (from 2nd year), sports place, OAT, garden area, meet-up area, large classrooms, auditorium, etc. When I joined, it was all a basic facilities college but each year the development was so fast. This university completely transformed all the infrastructure.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Digital Techniques for Design and Planning (DTDP) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: JNAFAU- DTDP, practicality at its the finest.

review_content.Placements: Since a government college, the placements are good. Internships at various companies for design, architecture and GIS are offered as well. We get to work with the government projects offered to us through the faculty. Roles offered are game develops, town planning, architecture and designing.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our classrooms are spacious and well kept. The library is huge and we have two labs. Wi-Fi is accessible to all. The canteen is up and running and the prices are student friendly too. There is no on campus hostel, but many near by to choose from.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Planning (SSS) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Dying path of Urban Planning.

review_content.Placements: Placements are practically zero, and students who do get jobs find them through their own internships and experience; without experience, finding jobs is extremely hard. Internships barely pay money, but after 5 to 7 years of experience in the planning field, pay is good.
review_content.Infrastructure: Very poor infrastructure, especially in my depth, had no proper projectors, and titles were broken in classrooms. If we wanted to use projectors, we had to check the lab, which had Pentium PCs that were very slow, and certain fans didn't work. My classroom had 4 sockets for 36 laptops, and when asked about increasing slots, my request was ignored.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Digital Techniques for Design and Planning (DTDP) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Jnafau, "The Diverse": This title is amazing because of its amazing course structure.

review_content.Placements: There were no placements provided by the college. Students have to find their internships on their own for the final year. These internships pay around INR 5,000–INR 10,000 per month. For their final semester, every student is required to do an internship. They do not provide any links or companies to approach; one has to approach companies on their own or through senior batches, and they do not care about the time.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure was top-notch, especially the library and classroom labs. They do not provide any hostels for girls, but they do provide one for boys from 2 and up, which was very poorly maintained. Though the hostels were bad, the college environment and landscaping were good. It's peaceful, and they also have a sports room and a canteen, along with stationary inside the college for necessities.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: A Good enough University for Architecture.

review_content.Placements: The highest stipend offered this year was 7.5k this year. We do have internships offered throughout the course period though. Since it is architecture so it's sort of expected to be low in the beginning. Placement cell isn't the finest in our university. There's not much you can expect in terms of placement because it is not an engineering course.
review_content.Infrastructure: Library is really good and so is the faculty and overall course structure. It is not bad, it's a good college. There's no hostel provided. Canteen is under construction and it would be ready soon enough. We have a sports room for indoor games like table tennis, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, you make good friends and go on educational trips but the faculty here is egoistic.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi at the college. There is no strong signal either. You have computer labs which are of old versions. Classrooms are okay, but in our classroom which is the 5th-floor 3rd studio. There is water leakage and there are no proper lockers or storage to keep our stuff. Benches are broken sometimes. Some can case bruises. There is no hostel in our college, so I don't know about the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Lucky enough to find a place like this to learn.
reviews.review_text: The institute was well-equipped with books, computers, Wi-Fi, laboratories, library, and tools whichever were needed for the course. We had a canteen and hostel facility (from 2nd year), sports place, OAT, garden area, meet-up area, large classrooms, auditorium, etc. When I joined, it was all a basic facilities college but each year the development was so fast. This university completely transformed all the infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: JNAFAU- DTDP, practicality at its the finest.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are spacious and well kept. The library is huge and we have two labs. Wi-Fi is accessible to all. The canteen is up and running and the prices are student friendly too. There is no on campus hostel, but many near by to choose from.

reviews.review_heading: Dying path of Urban Planning.
reviews.review_text: Very poor infrastructure, especially in my depth, had no proper projectors, and titles were broken in classrooms. If we wanted to use projectors, we had to check the lab, which had Pentium PCs that were very slow, and certain fans didn't work. My classroom had 4 sockets for 36 laptops, and when asked about increasing slots, my request was ignored.

reviews.review_heading: Jnafau, "The Diverse": This title is amazing because of its amazing course structure.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure was top-notch, especially the library and classroom labs. They do not provide any hostels for girls, but they do provide one for boys from 2 and up, which was very poorly maintained. Though the hostels were bad, the college environment and landscaping were good. It's peaceful, and they also have a sports room and a canteen, along with stationary inside the college for necessities.

reviews.review_heading: A Good enough University for Architecture.
reviews.review_text: Library is really good and so is the faculty and overall course structure. It is not bad, it's a good college. There's no hostel provided. Canteen is under construction and it would be ready soon enough. We have a sports room for indoor games like table tennis, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty and placements in 2021.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classes and library are available. We students are satisfied with all the facilities. The quality of food and medical facilities is very poor in the hostel. Students face problems with the college hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied a lot. A very good college with very good placements every year.
reviews.review_text: It's one of the best universities in Telangana and the one and only Fine Arts University in Telangana. With good infrastructure facilities. Hostel food is good to eat and can have a very good eco-friendly environment. It also provides good medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: JNAFAU has individual labs for every course with air-conditioning facilities. The classrooms are very spacious. The library is very spacious and has many books. Every book is available in the library. Hostel facilities are available, but many don't use them. An indoor games room is also available.

reviews.review_heading: College is not huge, but pleasant is more.
reviews.review_text: Smart classes and fine faculty and administration and playground is small. Hostel facility is avai5from 1st year and it is far away around 5kms from college. And college hostel is not well-equipped. Hostel fee is very low and it provides only B.Ed and water.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good for B.Arch and for fine arts courses.
reviews.review_text: The college provides lab and library facilities. Classrooms are better in our college. It provides internet, but it does not connect. There is no girls' hostel. It has dormitories for boys, which is not at all good with respect to my knowledge through my friends.

reviews.review_heading: Not really good at infrastructure and facilities but best at its faculty.
reviews.review_text: Though it is a government university, it does not seem like an university at all. There is a small ground which is used for parking vehicles mostly by outsiders. And besides this small ground there is no other ground in the university. There is no Wi-Fi available for students to work. There is no canteen for now, but it is in construction and may be opened by 2023. And coming to hostels, there is only one boys hostel for the university. But keeping these aside the best thing that university prov...

reviews.review_heading: It is the only college in India with good infrastructure and library at such a low cost.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is extremely good as it is an architectural college the design and all were nice. Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are digitalised & there is an extraordinary library in south India. The main thing is that the college hostel isn't that good and it's far away from the college. Canteen is under construction. Sports facilities are good enough. Overall the infrastructure is decent.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, and it has good faculty and management.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like computer lab, studio lab, and library are provided. Classrooms are big enough for 60 students. No ground is available in our college. The hostel is not provided for 1st-year students, but it is provided for all 2nd, 3rd, and 4th-year students. Mess is not available in hostels. There is a sports room in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is not good as it looks.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good enough. There is a computer lab, classrooms with blackboard and smartboard, Wi-Fi and India's 2nd big library with architecture books. The library is huge enough to study well. Our college hostel is situated in Abids, and the hostel will be below average. The food won't be provided in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Automobile Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Very good college for students seeking practical knowledge and for a little privileged ones too.

content.Placements: Outstanding placements, with the majority of students getting placed across the country. About 90 percent of the students who are seriously studying get internships. Tata Motors is one of the companies that gives placement to students.
content.Infrastructure: An 8/10 infrastructure with inbuilt hostels inside the college, having all the necessary labs and large playing areas, including three basketball courts, volleyball courts, a football ground, a stage, a seminar hall, and a different room for students fond of the automobile industry.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Information Technology (Cyber Security) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Students in our course are 180. We have the highest package of 57 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. All the students get internships from the college in companies such as CDAC, Oppidian India, Jubilant Engitech. Top roles offered in this course are cybersecurity analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is top-notch. We get Wi-Fi, a library, classrooms, and labs for each course. The hostel is well-maintained, and the food in the canteen and mess is also good. We have one health center in the college for emergencies. The college also has basketball, football, and volleyball grounds.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Digital Media and Marketing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: SSPU- The step to enter the practical world.

content.Placements: A total of 75 students were placed in our course and we were divided into 2 sections. 70% of the students had gotten college placements through the placement cell. The faculty and placement department had help on how to crack the job/internship selection process.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides us a huge library consisting of numerous varieties of books and novels to help us increase our knowledge. We are also provided with high-speed Wi-Fi to help us with our students work. We have our college hostel, which is optional. It has sports facilities, mess facilities and various other facilities given.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Digital Media and Marketing - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Symbiosis! The right choice.

content.Placements: There are 94 students in our course. The course is about how digital marketing is indeed and is important in today's world. Placements and internship programs are good. The average salary package offered ranges from 6-9 LPA, and the highest salary package offered in our department is 14 LPA.

Classrooms are equipped with projectors for better learning. There are seminar halls on each floor for guest lectures. The hostel is average and not worth the money paid.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Fintech - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Genuine review about the college.

content.Placements: The BBA Fintech course is related to fintech, regtech, and suptech. The college has partnerships with companies such as Paytm, Razorpay, TCS, and Mahindra. The program offers job opportunities in roles like data analysis and business analysis, with companies including Wipro and IBM. Almost 100% of students got placed in this course.

The hostel provides cleaning and laundry facilities. It has a gym along with football basketball and badminton courts. It provides good indoor games and many other things.

admission_overview.college_name: Bharath University Course Admission 2025: Eligibility, Selection Criteria, Application

paragraphs: Bharath University (Deemed-to-be) admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. The university conducts its own Bharath Engineering Entrance Examination (BEEE) to provide admission to UG Engineering courses.Bharath Institute of Higher Education and Researchalso accepts national-level entrance exams like NATA for admission to BArch courses. The mode of study at BU is full-time and part-time (classroom). The university offers more than a hundred courses at UG, PG and PhD levels through 18 schools and four institutes. The courses are offered in multiple streams like Management, Engineering, Science, Architecture, etc. Apart from the regular courses,BIHER Onlinecourses.

Candidates seeking admission atBharath University coursesmust meet the course-specific eligibility criteria.Bharath Institute of Higher Education and Research course admissionsare based on entrance exam scores.The basic eligibility for Bharath University UG course admissions is that the candidate must have passed class 12 and for PG courses, the candidates must have a bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline. Further,Bharath University course admissions are based on various entrance exam scores such asNEET, NEET SS, NEET PG etc as per respective courses. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularBharath University courses:

Candidates must have completed 17 years of age as on December 31 of the academic year

Bharath University course admission processis a multi-step process. The University offers admission to various courses at UG and PG level based on merit or entrance exam. Candidates willing to secure a seat must meet the Bharath University course eligibility criteria and then follow the steps mentioned below:
Bharath University Application Process:

Bharath University application processis conducted online on itsofficial website. The candidate needs to apply for their desired course and pay the required Bharath University application fee to confirm their submission.
Bharath University Selection Rounds:

The University shortlists candidates either based on merit in the qualifying exam or through the entrance exam. Bharath University conducts its engineering entrance examBEEE. Apart from BEEE, the university acceptsNEETfor admission to the MBBS programme.
Bharath University Final Admission:
After shortlisting candidates, Bharath University makes final admission offers. Selected candidates need to pay the admission confirmation fee to secure their seat at the University.

placement_data.title: Bharath University Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: The highest and average package offered during Bharath University placements 2023 stood at INR 27 LPA and INR 4.5 LPA , respectively. Further, the placement rate recorded was 94%. A total of 1835 job offers were made.

Earlier, the University has concluded its placement drive for the batch passed out in 2022 with 93% placement rate . The highest and average package offered was INR 14 LPA and INR 4.5 LPA, respectively . 207 recruiters participated in the placement process and placed 1616 students in new-age job roles. Out of the total students placed, 1,584 were from the BTech , 18 were from the MBA and 14 were from the MCA course. Amazon, Tech Mahindra Infosys, TCS, Accenture, Cognizant, HCL were among the top recruiters of Bharath University in 2022 .

paragraphs: Rajiv Gandhi South Campusoffers admission to UG and PG courses based on entrance exam scores. Candidates are first required to apply for the accepted entrance exam. Below are the steps to get a seat in RGSC BHU:
STEP 1: RGSC BHU Application Process 2025

Candidates can apply online for admission at RGSC BHU. For most of the UG courses, candidates will need to apply for CUET-UG. Aspirants applying for PG programmes need to fill out the CUET-PG application form. Candidates who wish to get admission without CUET score can apply on the official website of BHU.
STEP 2: Selection

The selection for UG courses such as BSc, BCom (Hons), BVoc and BMLT is based on CUET-UG score. For PG courses such as MSc, MVoc, MBA, etc. candidates need to pass CUET-PG exam. Candidates must score marks equal or above theRGSC BHU cutoffto get admission.
STEP 3: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Candidates are allotted seat in RGSC through BHU Counselling. Candidates after appearing for CUET-UG or CUET-PG exam need to participate in the counselling round. Selected aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the campus.

The mode of application is online. Aspirants can download and fill the form available on the institute website. Candidates need to pay an application fee of INR 500 to register for a course. Candidates belonging to SC/ ST/ PWD category are exempted from paying the application fee.
STEP 2: Selection

The institute conducts SVPET for shortlisting candidates for UG and PG admission. SVP Entrance Test is an online test conducted for one-hour duration. The test includes 50 MCQs for both UG and PG courses. Aspirants can also get admission to UG and PG courses based on CUET-UG and CUET-PG scores, respectively.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation
Once the candidates are selected, they need to submit the specified documents for verification. They need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

individual_reviews.title: Centurion University review.

content.Placements: The placement in our course was the best among all courses. The placement percentage was around 85–90 percent. The highest package was also secured by our course only, i.e., 22 LPA. The average package was around 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, Deloitte, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facilities, a library, and modern classrooms were available. Computer labs, laboratories, and workshops were well equipped with instruments. Hostel quality was also good. Sports and games were encouraged by the college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: You will enjoy the college.

content.Placements: Only a few students were placed, nearly 35% students in our course. Minimum package is 3 LPA, and the highest I don't have any valid proof because college says nearly 24, but we don't believe. Wipro, Amazon, and TCS recruit. More of them were placed in Wipro or TCS. Software engineer and supervisor roles were offered.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good, and I recommend you visit it as there are lots of places like the butterfly garden, gram tarang, etc. Wi-Fi is here, but don't rely on it as they have less network speed. The library is here, but it doesn't have new books, all are old. The hostel is very bad, I heard it, but I don't know that much because I am a day scholar.

content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is the best. There are many types in our college. A big ground, a volleyball court, a gym area, and a swimming pool are available in the college. The classroom is completely AC and very spacious.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering - Batch of 2024

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Master of Science (M.Sc.) + Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is recognized as one of the best skill institutions in Odisha.

Many graduates are recruited by these same hospitals based on their performance, and there are also opportunities to secure positions at renowned institutions such as AIIMS.
content.Infrastructure: College is set in a peaceful and green environment, making it a pleasant place to study. The hostels are well-maintained, with spacious rooms and all necessary facilities provided. Hostel wardens are also very cooperative and ensure students feel comfortable.

paragraphs: Centurion University of Technology and Management (CUTM) Bhubaneswar, offers UG, PG and Diploma courses with a diverse range of over 100 courses across various fields, includingEngineering, Management,Science, Mass Communication and Media,Design, Hotel Management, and Pharmacy. ForCenturion University Bhubaneswaradmissions, candidates are required to appear for the CUEE which is conducted by the University. Admission to courses offered in the field of Management, Technology, Science and Engineering requires a valid score in CUEE.

Centurion University Bhubaneswar coursesoffer a range of diploma, UG, PG, research-level and certificate programmes offered through multiple departments working under it. Some of the popular courses offered at Centurion University Bhubaneswar are mentioned in below table along with their eligibility criteria:
Class 12 (Physics, Chemistry, Maths) with 50% aggregate (5% relaxation for reserved category)
BSc in respective disciplines
Bachelor's degree
Class 12 (Physics, Chemistry, Maths/Biology) with 45% aggregate
CUEE BPharm

Step 1: ApplicationTheprocess ofadmissionat Centurion University of Technology and Managementstartswiththe online application formsubmittedonitsofficialwebsiteby the aspirant.Inadditiontotheapplication,thefeewouldbeleviedaspertheprogrammechosen.However,inadditiontothat, the candidate is supposedto upload scanned copies of documentsincludingacademic transcripts, mark sheets, certificates, and a passport-sizephotograph.

Step 2: Entrance ExamSome of the programmes at the university have entrance examination of their own, referred to as CUEE. On the other hand, some of the university takes specific scores from national level exams like JEE Main, SAT, or even any other national level exam for entrance purpose. Candidates can choose between appearing in CUEE or submitting their scorecard for national level exam; however, this depends upon the rules followed by the program.

Step 3: Selection and CounsellingAfter the application and entrance exam (if applicable), candidates are shortlisted based on their scores. Those who are shortlisted will then be called for counseling, after which they can choose their program depending on merit and seat availability. To confirm their seat, candidates must accept the seat offered to them and pay the admission fee. After seat acceptance, original documents must be submitted for verification to complete the admission process.

reviews.review_heading: Centurion University review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facilities, a library, and modern classrooms were available. Computer labs, laboratories, and workshops were well equipped with instruments. Hostel quality was also good. Sports and games were encouraged by the college.

reviews.review_heading: You will enjoy the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good, and I recommend you visit it as there are lots of places like the butterfly garden, gram tarang, etc. Wi-Fi is here, but don't rely on it as they have less network speed. The library is here, but it doesn't have new books, all are old. The hostel is very bad, I heard it, but I don't know that much because I am a day scholar.

reviews.review_heading: Also a very good college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is the best. There are many types in our college. A big ground, a volleyball court, a gym area, and a swimming pool are available in the college. The classroom is completely AC and very spacious.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied with the college. Infrastructure, facilities, faculty members, and all are good.
reviews.review_text: Every possible facility is available in the college as well as the hostel. Food is good, Wi-Fi was available, and the Lab was also very useful. They also have an option available of AC luxury in a hostel that was value for money. I also chose the luxury one, and all the facilities were good.

reviews.review_heading: College is recognized as one of the best skill institutions in Odisha.
reviews.review_text: College is set in a peaceful and green environment, making it a pleasant place to study. The hostels are well-maintained, with spacious rooms and all necessary facilities provided. Hostel wardens are also very cooperative and ensure students feel comfortable.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members and better jobs are provided by our college.
reviews.review_text: Our department boasted well-equipped laboratories, smart classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, and access to a huge library. The hostel provided neat rooms, hygienic mess, and 24x7 medical attention. There are cricket, football, and indoor games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College has strong practical learning and infrastructure, but faculty availability needs improvement
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Classrooms are highly maintained, and Wi-fi is available. The library is also provided in our college. The college hostels are good, but the food quality in the mess is not good. In the CUTM, they have a big sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Value of money for students.
reviews.review_text: The college has Wi-Fi facilities, and the labs and halls are air-conditioned. There are plenty of computers available on campus, and they are all well maintained. Different types of hostels are available; if you want air-conditioned rooms, they are available, and attached bathrooms are also an option.

reviews.review_heading: Strong faculty & good jobs.
reviews.review_text: Our department had well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and access to a vast library. The hostel offered clean rooms, hygienic mess food, and 24/7 medical support. Sports facilities included cricket, football, and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is also quite good. We have well-equipped labs for all the different subjects like Pharmacology, Pharmaceutics, Pharmacognosy, Medicinal Chemistry, etc., along with smart classrooms. The main library is spacious and digitally enabled. The hostel facilities are decent, and the sports department is very good.

reviews.review_heading: An overall really good experience as a B.Tech CSE student!
reviews.review_text: The older hostels were quite congested and not very satisfactory. The food served is often criticized for being unappetizing and poorly prepared; some students have reported finding insects in it. There are many lab classes, but only two can accommodate 60+ students at once.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our courses like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library are good. The quality of facilities in our hostel, the quality of food available in the mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games are good.

reviews.review_heading: At last, it is the best college if u want to study.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities for students. All classrooms have AC and their own smart boards. All classrooms have their personal Wi-Fi. The best thing is that you can go to the library when you want for what time you want. They give good food in the hostel canteen and excellent facilities for hostel students. Also, present a personal doctor for the hostel and for sports injuries.

reviews.review_heading: The campus review of CUTM.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good except for its food. The hostel costs are also affordable. They are the most secure places. More often some clubs provide you with sports and entertainment purposes as we can enjoy the nightlife of the college. There a many stalls. We can enjoy being there and gossiping around with friends.

reviews.review_heading: A very good college with good faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: College facilities are very good. The college infrastructure is also very good. Every single classroom has an AC and Wi-Fi system. The library environment is very good. The canteen food quality is not good. The food and hostel rooms are very disappointing.

course_faqs.question: Is MCA available at Pondicherry University?
course_faqs.answer: Yes, Pondicherry University offers a three-year MCA programme spread over six semesters. The course is available at the Department of Computer Science of the Puducherry campus and at the Department of Computer Science of the Karaikal campus of Pondicherry University. A total of 125 seats are available combined at both campuses out of which 75 are available at the Puducherry campus while the remaining 50 are offered at the Karaikal campus.

overview_faqs.question: What is the application fee for MCA at Pondicherry University?
overview_faqs.answer: The application fee of MCA for all category candidates is INR 300. Students can pay the application fee online while registering for the course. In addition to the application and tiotion fee, there are several other components included in the overall fee structure for MCA. The details of the component-wise fee can be obtained from the official brochure, some of the components which are part of the overall MBA course fee include registration fee, matriculation fee, sports fund, medical examination/ facilities fund, library fund, computer lab fund, amenities development fund, students’ welfare fund and caution deposit (refundable), among various others. Read more about Pondicherry University MCA here.

overview_faqs.question: Does Pondicherry University provide Distance Education to the students?
overview_faqs.answer: Apart from the full-time programmes, the University offers distance education programmes in the field of Management, Commerce, Arts, Business Administration and more. Admission to all these programmes is done on the basis of merit.BBA and BCom are offered at the UG level. The course duration of both programmes is three years. Candidates who have done Class 12 can apply for these programmes. The final selection of students is based on the HSC scores.Apart from the UG programmes, the University offers three PG programmes under distance education. MCom, MA and MBA are offered with a course duration of two years. A candidate must hold a bachelor’s degree in the relevant stream to be eligible for these programmes. The final selection of students will be based on the graduation scores.

overview_faqs.question: How expensive is MBA at Pondicherry University?
overview_faqs.answer: The tuition fee for MBA at Pondicherry University is between INR 24,930 and INR 2.4 lakh. Students should also pay a registration fee of INR 300 while filling the application form. The aforementioned tuition fee is is indicative. individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Statistics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Pondicherry University is gorgeous.

content.Placements: Since there hasn't been any batch that has completed their graduation after the university started following the new NEP guidelines, there haven't been any placements made yet. Prior to the implementation of the NEP guidelines, the average package that students got from statistics was around 4 LPA-6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities available right now have been used for a long time and haven't been updated yet in classrooms and labs. But the medical facilities are good, with proper canteens available across the campus. Wi-Fi provided is of good quality in certain places, reaching even up to 16 Mbps/sec.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Great place to study, but still, there is way more that can be improved.

content.Placements: The UG programme for our course has just started 2years back, so none of the batch has been placed yet. Though the Master's programme in this course has started long back, and the placements are below average, I feel. Not sure if the same applies to UG students as well.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is huge and spread across 800 acres. We have all the amenities, including all the required labs, proper classrooms for students, seminar halls, and conference rooms. Hostel mess provides hygienic and nutritious food all the 3 times a day. The menu is well planned, including a proper diet. We also have a health centre where health services are provided free of cost.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Material Science and Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Best for students who like the B.Tech and make connections with different countries students.

content.Placements: First of all, yours is the 2nd batch in this university. Before that, there was M. Tech for the last 2 years, and they started B.Tech, which is good. Coming to the placement part, it's quite good, not below average. Compared to other universities, this is a central university, so it's good in that case. I have no idea about the highest package place, but I have heard that the highest is 40 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Coming to facilities and infrastructure, it's very good for our department, which has a newly designed building with an AI sensor corridor light, which was used from 2015. The hostel is good with very well furnished rooms and the best maintenance and cleaning all around the campus, not only in the toilets. Mess food is good for what we are paying, like we are paying, and the canteen service is very good. Medical is next-level full fee, with well-maintained hygiene, and also 24/7. Sports and games are also available with very good grounds and a stadium.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a nice place to build our career.

content.Placements: Placements are quite good. My seniors are getting placed in Wabag, Chennai. Some other good companies also hire students. Packages offered are quite good for those who have nice company. For internships, faculty members will give permission to some of the popular institutes and industries.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. The network connection is quite poor, to be honest. We have library facilities. Our college conducts tournaments every year for all sports. Inter-college matches are available for all sports. The canteen food is below average.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Disaster Management - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: No placement. Friendly faculty members.

content.Placements: There is no placement after the course completion. We need to find our own jobs. After the completion of the course, you will get a Pondicherry University Certificate. After this course, learn any other skills like GIS, Python, etc. It will be helpful. Experience is required for a high-earning job in this field. Start from the DDMA, and we get a job.
content.Infrastructure: There is less equipment, and some equipment does not work properly. The department has one smartboard and Wi-Fi connection. There is a common library for the college. The food was average. The mess is contract-based, every year, it changes. Inside, there is a hostel committee and a campus committee, which conduct programmes, etc. There is a small ground in the hostel for throwball, cricket, football, etc.

faqs.question: Can I join Pondicherry University without entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Admission to a majority of postgraduate and integrated postgraduate level courses at Pondicherry University is subject to CUET UG and CUET PG exams. In addition to this, the university also conducted the NCET exam for admission to its Integrated BA-B.Ed, Integrated BSc-B.Ed courses. Candidates seeking admission to Pondicherry University can apply for these exams and then apply to the university with a valid score.

faqs.question: Is BSc available in Pondicherry University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Pondicherry University offers a BSc programme with various courses spread across its affiliated colleges. The main campus of the university offers five-year MSc integrated courses for students wanting to pursue PG-integrated courses. Moreover, students seeking admission in regular three-year BSc courses can do so by applying at Pondicherry University’s affiliated colleges.

faqs.question: Does Pondicherry University provide Distance Education to the students?
faqs.answer: Apart from the full-time programmes, the University offers distance education programmes in the field of Management, Commerce, Arts, Business Administration and more. Admission to all these programmes is done on the basis of merit.BBA and BCom are offered at the UG level. The course duration of both programmes is three years. Candidates who have done Class 12 can apply for these programmes. The final selection of students is based on the HSC scores.Apart from the UG programmes, the University offers three PG programmes under distance education. MCom, MA and MBA are offered with a course duration of two years. A candidate must hold a bachelor’s degree in the relevant stream to be eligible for these programmes. The final selection of students will be based on the graduation scores.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for BSc at Pondicherry University?
faqs.answer: Under the BSc programme, Pondicherry University offers various specialisations. These specialisations are distributed amongst the university’s affiliated colleges. Thus, each course may have different eligibility criteria depending on the college. However, the common eligibility criterion is a pass in Class 12.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for MCA at Pondicherry University?
faqs.answer: The application fee of MCA for all category candidates is INR 300. Students can pay the application fee online while registering for the course. In addition to the application and tiotion fee, there are several other components included in the overall fee structure for MCA. The details of the component-wise fee can be obtained from the official brochure, some of the components which are part of the overall MBA course fee include registration fee, matriculation fee, sports fund, medical examination/ facilities fund, library fund, computer lab fund, amenities development fund, students’ welfare fund and caution deposit (refundable), among various others. Read more about Pondicherry University MCA here .

faqs.question: How expensive is MBA at Pondicherry University?
faqs.answer: The tuition fee for MBA at Pondicherry University is between INR 24,930 and INR 2.4 lakh . Students should also pay a registration fee of INR 300 while filling the application form. The aforementioned tuition fee is is indicative. Some of the components which are the part MBA course fee include registration fee, matriculation fee, sports fund and development fund.

faqs.question: What is the total fee for Pondicherry University BSc course?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for Pondicherry University BSc courses is INR 1,100 to 1.1 lakh as per official sources. However, it is still subject to changes. Hence, it is, indicative. Apart from this, the fee structure for Pondicherry University courses contains various other fee components such as Registration & Processing Fee, Study Material & Handling Charges, Matriculation Fee, etc. Students are advised to visit the official site of the university to find out the detailed fee structure.

reviews.review_heading: Pondicherry University is gorgeous.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available right now have been used for a long time and haven't been updated yet in classrooms and labs. But the medical facilities are good, with proper canteens available across the campus. Wi-Fi provided is of good quality in certain places, reaching even up to 16 Mbps/sec.

reviews.review_heading: Great place to study, but still, there is way more that can be improved.
reviews.review_text: The campus is huge and spread across 800 acres. We have all the amenities, including all the required labs, proper classrooms for students, seminar halls, and conference rooms. Hostel mess provides hygienic and nutritious food all the 3 times a day. The menu is well planned, including a proper diet. We also have a health centre where health services are provided free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Best for students who like the B.Tech and make connections with different countries students.

On this campus, you will get a Nescafe outlet with a huge canteen. For emergency in one building medical facilities are there.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good autonomous college, with good placements in 2021, and excellent ambience.
reviews.review_text: It's an underdeveloped college that still has great infrastructure with good ambience and a healthy environment to grow. Girls' hostels are built on the campus, and boys' hostels are built outside. Canteen food is delicious, while sports department helps with physical growth.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: Course curriculum is really good and designed to prepare students well for the corporate environment. The only downside is that the syllabus can be quite hectic. The first four semesters are full-time on campus, while in the last two semesters, students can either do internships with companies for three days a week and attend college for two days, or, if they don’t find an internship, they can work on in-house projects. Separate hostel and mess facilities are available for boys and girls, servin...

reviews.review_heading: A place to grow and shine.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are spacious and airy providing a good atmosphere to make students engage with the teaching. Labs are also very good, and the library does contain useful information about every topic. About the hostel, it is way more than you expect. Providing a great environment of nature and friendly staff to engage with students and maintain discipline. Providing every facility like medical, sports, canteen, good mess, and many more. Topmost is the security of it.

There are 2 canteens in our college, one is average, and the other is the worst, just a waste of money. The mess outside the hostel in the college is good, tasty, and nice, but the mess located inside the hostel is the worst.

The air quality is really good. Classrooms are decent size along with labs, library, Wi-Fi, and canteen. The mess quality in the hostel is average and sports and games are unappreciated.

reviews.review_heading: PCU is the best university for studying.
reviews.review_text: PCU has good facilities, and it provides Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library. I don't have an idea of the hostel. From hostel friends, I got to know that PCU provides the best hostel, 24-hour water supply, and electricity. Mess is also good. PCU provides ground in the hostel so that students can play sports.

reviews.review_heading: Decent academics, room for growth.

Regarding the hostel: The girls' hostel is on the campus whereas the boys' hostel is located 3kms away from the campus, the college provides transportation facilities if you opt for a hostel. Hostel rooms are well maintained but the food isn't good. Also, the hostel h...

However, there is an issue with the mess, as the food is bad in taste and sometimes not available. But you can find cheaper options if you live outside on your own.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: We have a lift in our hostel, and washing machines are not provided on each floor. We have to go climb till 5th floor on foot. However, the food is good, and they provide us with the best quality of everything, and this year, these problems will also be resolved.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Pimpri Chinchwad University (PCU).
reviews.review_text: On campus, there are much prettier facilities and infrastructure. Labs are fully organised. The college library has a collection of technology and course-related books for students. The hostel is so good and the better is a girls' hostel as it is located on the college campus with assured security. Boys have 2...

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good.

reviews.review_heading: College is very best, and beneficial for us.

Digital library and library is also available. Library is equipped with many books. College is located at mountain side. There are no distractions while studying.

faqs.question: Is it difficult to get admission in School of Health Sciences and Technology Courses, UPES - Experience Centre?
faqs.answer: Admission to UPES - Experience Centre can vary in difficulty depending on the chosen admission pathway. There are three options available: UPSEAT (which covers 80% of seats), Board marks (for which exceptional scores are required), and JEE Main marks for All India seats. If you are aiming for admission through UPSEAT, it's generally considered more competitive, and you should aim for a rank of at least 600 in the exam to increase your chances of securing a spot at the college. The difficulty level of admission can also be influenced by factors such as the number of applicants and the specific programme you are applying to. It's advisable to research the admission criteria and requirements for your chosen course to understand the level of competitiveness involved.

faqs.question: Does UPES - Experience Centre accept MAT score?
faqs.answer: No, the UPES - Experience Centredoes not accept the MAT score for MBA admissions. On the other hand, the UPES School of Business does accept the MAT score, with a minimum eligible MAT/CMAT 2024 score of 70 percentile exempting students from the UPES Management Entrance Test. Therefore, if you have a MAT score and are considering applying for an MBA at UPES, the School of Business would be the appropriate choice for your application.

Apart from this, students should also meet other criteria that the University has chosen to avail the scholarship.

UPES - Experience Centre will provide a concession in fees based on scores scored by students in the entrance exam, such as JEE Main, JEE Advanced, CUET, CBSE (+2), and exams from other central/ State boards of India.

3. Free Ships Scholarship

The UPES’ Free Ships Scholarships are built to uplift prospective students from low-income families without added clauses or strings attached. A total of 51 seats are allotted with an upper age limit of 20 years for UG programs and 25 years for PG programs - and are provided on both the tuition fee and hostel fee.

4. Sports Scholarships

The University allotted 50 seats for sportspeople who excel in a range of sports from cricket, football, and athletics to shooting, chess, and table tennis; as it aims to make sports an inclusive part of the academic curriculum. The scholarship percentile under this impressive initiative ranges from 35% to 100% depending on the number of national & international sports achievements a candidate has.

highlights.summary:
Reliance Education VFX and Animation Academy nurture the future leaders of moving art. The academy is counted amongst the top institutes offering VFX and animation courses in India. It maintains centres in Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Patna, Chandigarh, Bhubaneswar, Cochin, Noida, Varanasi, Gurugram, Nagpur, Agra, Mathura, Kannur, Aurangabad, Meerut, Bhilai, Alwar and Kanpur.

Some of the popular vocational courses offered by Reliance Education include Triple Programme in VFX, Advanced Programme in VFX, Triple Programme in Animation, Advanced Programme in Animation, Programme in Maya Master, Programme in TV Cartoon Animation with 3D, Programme in VFX Film Making, Programme in Advanced Maya with Film Fundamentals, Graphic Plus & Web Plus and Game Testing. Besides professional programmes, Reliance Education offers preparatory courses for various entrance examinations including NIFT, NID, CEED and MIT Institute of Design.

The animation and VFX films made by Reliance Education have been awarded and nominated in various film festivals like FICCI - BAF Awards, Kolkata Shorts International Film Festival, Delhi Shorts International Film Festival, Dada Saheb Phalke Film Festival, Goa Short Film Festival and FTII National Student's Film Festival.

Admission to the programmes offered at Reliance Education VFX and Animation Academy is done through lateral entry. Students must have the minimum required qualifications for the respective courses they want to pursue.

Students of Reliance Education VFX and Animation Academy are absorbed by leading studios including Reliance Entertainment, Maya Digital Studio, Xentric Studios, Tata ELXSI, Symbiosis Technologies, HMX Studios and R Media. Further, Reliance Education has partnered with Discovery Communication India for animated film production. Students of Reliance Education VFX and Animation Academy are recruited in various roles like Pre Production Artist, 3D FX Artist, Storyboard Artist, Character Designer, Roto Artist, Editor, Animator, CGI Compositor, Virtual Production Developer, Product Demo Artist, 3D AR-VR Background Artist, Modelling Artist, Texturing Artist and 3D Modelling Artist.

review_content.Placements: Placements in our college are good but not the best because they just left us on our own, and they helped us in few things. reviews_list.review_title: Our college provides average placements.

review_content.Placements: Placements are average and aren't worth it. Placements are offered in India only. Those are freelancing options. Most students got placements, and some work as freelancers. Placements are helpful and useful.

review_content.Faculty: Teachers aren't even average when it comes to teaching. They only teach the basics, and we have to do the rest on our own. They clear up our doubts. Exams are conducted normally as it is necessary to test the knowledge and efficiency of students.

paragraphs: ITM SLS Baroda University admission 2026is currently open. ITM (SLS) Baroda offers courses, such as BTech, BBA, MBA, etc., at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the institute also offers diploma courses. To get admission toITM SLS Baroda University, meet the eligibility criteria of the preferred course. The university offers more than 10 courses in various streams such as Design, Engineering, Mass Communication & Media, etc. The application process at ITM SLS Baroda University is conducted online. Read the following article to know more aboutITM SLS Baroda Universitycourse admission2026.

ITM SLS Baroda University courses' admissions are based on the entrance exam and merit basis. Candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements of the respective courses. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popular ITM SLS Baroda University courses:
Check here for detailed eligibility criteria for moreITM SLS Baroda University courses

ITM SLS Baroda University has a multi-step admission process that students need to follow to get into ITM SLS Baroda University. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website of the university post where interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission. Additionally, Admission to all the ITM SLS Baroda University programmes is based on merit and entrance exam. Candidates must check the eligibility criteria on the official website of ITM SLS Baroda University, before filling out the admission form. Interested candidates can check below the complete ITM SLS Baroda University admission process:
Step 1: ITM SLS Baroda University Application Process
The mode of ITM SLS Baroda University application is online. Candidates must register online and then fill the online application form.
Step 2: ITM SLS Baroda University Selection rounds
ITM SLS Baroda University shortlists candidates either based on merit or entrance exam. After shortlisting candidates, selected candidates receive a provisional admission letter.
Step 3: Final Admission confirmation
To confirm admission at ITM SLS Baroda University, selected candidates need to pay theITM SLS Baroda University feeand visit the university campus for the document verification process.

faqs.question: How much does MBA at SGBAU cost?
faqs.answer: SGBAU Amravati has 30 departments that offer certificate, undergraduate, graduate, and PhD level programmes in science, engineering, management, business, education, the arts, law, and lifelong learning. It offers a 2 years MBA programme with specializations in Financial Management, Marketing Management, Human Resources Management, Production and Operations Management. The total fees for the MBA programme at SGBAU is INR 80,600. A bachelor's degree in any field with at least 50% of the required courses completed is required for entrance to the MBA program. You can read more information about the MBA programme at Sant Gadge Baba Amravati University on the following site - https://www.shiksha.com/university/sant-gadge-baba-amravati-university-22416/courses

The fully automated central library was available. The hostel provided spacious and well-ventilated accommodations for 320 students. A modern auditorium equipped with the latest technology. The food quality standards of the hostel were okayish, and the medical facilities were good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities and an attracting garden, with good placements in IT field

It's a friendly environment to develop our skills and we have a lot of opportunities to work for our passion. We were also asked to participate in sports in addition to placements and academics.

reviews.review_heading: My postgraduate degree in Physics at vimala college.

In our canteen, we are served hygienic food and also have a specific menu to follow every day. All modes of transportation are available from our college campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college focuses on providing the best quality education to its students.

The library and canteen were available on the college campus. Our college also promotes sports and provides multiple sports facilities to the students. I have not opted for the hostel facility.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vimala college Autonomous Thrissur .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Vimala college Autonomous Thrissur is awesome. The building is renovated every year and the facilities available at the college are good. The college has many recreation spots. The college hostel is not good comparing to other PG hostels .

reviews.review_heading: Vimala College Autonomous, Thrissur - My overall experience.
reviews.review_text: Every classroom is Vimala College has a projector facility in each class. In the mathematics department, there is a departmental computer lab. So it is easy, accessible, and helpful for students. Computers in the lab have Wi-Fi connectivity, and students can use it, but students can't get college Wi-Fi for their personal devices. There is a large library with a garden library arranged in it. There are a lot of books in the library related to my core subject, mathematics, but there are not a wide...

reviews.review_heading: I like the hostel and the food of this University.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is too good with all the facilities available. The mess is also good. The infrastructure of the rooms and the bathrooms is kept neat and clean. Gym is also available. Nescafe is also available for eating and recreation purposes. The hostel is best in every way possible. It is properly cleaned and there is a 24*7 security guard available at the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Kerala
reviews.review_text: Students get hostel facilities in the college. They get all the basic facilities in the hostel, including Wi-Fi/LAN facilities. The taste of the food in the mess is good. Many sports facilities are available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Campus and hostel of this college is very wonderful.
reviews.review_text: There are hostels with single rooms, which means each student gets a single room or shared room. The diet plan is made by students of the hostel. Food quality and quantity are very good and the monthly mess fees are like 2400–2800. Security guards are always at the main gate, or security guards roam on the hostel campus. The registration process is very easy; it is done by filling out the form.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best university.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in BHU IIT?
faqs.answer: The students who wants to get admission into BHU IIT, Varanasi must meet the minimum eligibility criteria for the course. faqs.question: Who is eligible for IIT BHU MTech?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have BE/BTech/MSc or equivalent with (a) CGPA 6.00 on a 10-point scale or 60% marks in aggregate for General/OBC (Non Creamy Layer)/EWS. Earlier, during the 2024-25 session , the highest and average stipend recorded was INR 5 lakh and 1.04 lakh per month .

The sports facility is also very good. The canteen ...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with my college IIT BHU because of facilities and good placement in 2026.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good at IIT BHU. Wi-Fi covers the entire campus, and classrooms are fully modernized. There are 4 lecture theatres in our college. For freshers, IIT BHU has the best hostel among all IITs, named PC Ray Hostel, which covers all required infrastructure and is newly made, so it looks aesthetic as well. There are 3 huge grounds in IIT BHU, which cover facilities for all sports. We have SAC for indoor games and a newly made gym, which is the biggest sports auditorium as well.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college ancient college in India.

The sports facilities in our college are excellent. There are 23 sports that are introduced in our college. In our college there are multiple clubs for the interests of every individual in our college. Our hostel is the newly ...

reviews.review_heading: IIT Bhu is a vibe, go enjoy it.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a library named the Shrinivas Despande Library. It had a vast collection of the latest and historical books. The facilities in the classroom were the latest but they do not have AC in the classroom but it contains a smart board, a green board and a projector. Our college had a gym which had the latest equipment and also three grounds. 2 volleyball court 2 lawn tennis court and many more courts for different games. Mainly, our college had a building name sac which contains all ind...

reviews.review_heading: Our college is nice we love it.
reviews.review_text: We have good food, a mess, Wi-Fi, a ibrary and a lot of things. The structure of labs and classrooms is old, it is already a bit old, but new halls are being built which are very good. Initially there are good facilities in the hostel but later on it happens that there is no water and the geyser is facility.

reviews.review_heading: IIT BHU, The best of the most.
reviews.review_text: One thing in which my college lags is infrastructure. It is not as great as other IITs. They are working heavily on improving it. New hostels are being made. Canteen services are being improved. Wi-Fi is good. AC is also being installed.

reviews.review_heading: I have an amazing experience at IIT BHU Varanasi.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good, but not so cool compared to other IITs. Day by day, infrastructure is getting better. Hostels are also getting renovated, and the new ones are quite good (for 1st and 2nd year). Mess food is obviously very good. The canteen is open till 3 AM, so it's very helpful.

reviews.review_heading: College is the support for all the sports and infrastructure, and the food is good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the hostel are good, with table tennis, volleyball, and a badminton court. Food quality is very nice. Wi-Fi in the classroom is somewhat limited, but in the library it's excellent. An excellent thing about this college is the support for all the sports and infrastructure, and the food is also very good, with a protein-rich diet.

reviews.review_heading: Overview for freshers in 2026.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not very modern but its bearable. In recent months it has upgraded a lot by adding ACs and new buildings. Wi-Fi is great all over the campus from the start, hostel rooms and bathrooms are good as well for a government college. There is a variety of food in the mess at a time and the menu is not repeated all week.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college if you are going for placement.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is okay, the classrooms are old, basically, the whole infrastructure is old. Some buildings are good. First-year hostels are good. The food provided in the mess is good. Sports and games facilities are also good. The infrastructure is kind of old, and we do not have AC in the lecture theatre (now being installed).

reviews.review_heading: My college is good, the best for placements and much more. You will have quality time for a duration
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is okay, not that good. There is no such AC and no more big building new hostels are being built but those are for seniors because for 1 st year there are good hostels. Sports facilities are not good in hostels. You have to go to college facilities for that, and the medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college in Uttar Pradesh.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my department is good. The past is the nearest department. Hostels have CCTV cameras, a water cooler, vending machines, and a canteen. The quality of the food is good. We have a study room in the hostel. There is a common room on each floor in which we play table tennis.

reviews.review_heading: Lifetime experience in IIT BHU.
reviews.review_text: The library has vast resources, and classrooms are a mix of modern smart rooms and older halls. Hostels are mandatory for B.Tech students & very affordable. Rooms are mostly double/triple sharing for juniors with basic facilities, a bed, table, chair and cupboard. The mess food is average with a varied menu of North/South Indian dishes.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Technology, BHU, Varanasi.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available are old, but everything needed is provided to us. Wi-Fi facilities are absolutely good. Classrooms are okay. The library is an absolute part of our college, and it has all types of book collections needed for a student. The hostel rooms are too cozy and small. The food is not that good in taste, but the quality is good enough.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not very modern. The Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. The classrooms, library, and labs are very calm without any disturbance. The hostels and mess are very neat. The college has a hospital. For sports, we have several grounds and a student activity centre.

NIF Global Andheri offers UG, PG, and certificate courses across Design, Management, and others. The flagship courses offered at NIF Global Andheri are BDes and BVoc. paragraphs: NIF Global Andherioffers many courses across the fields of Fashion Design, Interior Design, Design Management, and others. These courses are offered at UG, PG, and diploma levels. Students can also pursue vocational courses at the institute. Admissions to most of the programmes offered atNIF Andheriare done based on academic merit. However, for its MBA course admission, the institute accepts students on an entrance basis. Read the following article to know all about the courses, eligibility, selection criteria, and admission process of NIF Andheri.

Admissions toNIF Global Andheri coursesare accepted both based on merit secured by the applicants in the entrance exam and the relevant qualifying exam. For admissions to its undergraduate, postgraduate (except for MBA), diploma and certificate courses, the institute considers merit secured in the last qualifying exam. For MBA admission, NIF Global Andheri takes into consideration MAH CET marks. The table below contains details regarding the eligibility and selection criteria for the popularNIF Andheri courses:

The admission procedure for the NIFGlobal Andheri admission processincludes several steps, such as application, shortlisting, and admission confirmation. Interested students must satisfy the admission criteria as specified by the institute before applying for the desired course at the institute. Aspirants can follow the steps listed below to complete theNIF Global Andheri admission process:
1: Application Process

Candidates who meet the eligibility can visit the official website to fill out the form online. The students need to select the desired course, fill in all the specified details, pay the application fee and upload the required documents to complete the registration.
2: Selection Process

The institute shortlists students based on various parameters. For its MBA course admissions, a valid score secured by the candidates in the MHT CET is considered. Furthermore, for the remaining courses, the institute accepts students on a merit basis.
3: Counselling and Fee Payment
The shortlisted candidates will have to pay the course fee and submit the required documents to confirm their seat in the college.
